title: Chum Scare
tagline: An abandoned mall. An empty revolver. Something behind you.
warning: This game has sudden loud sounds, flashing light and things that move when you are not looking. Headphones are best.
bless_line_one: What I let in through the screen, leaves through the screen.
bless_line_two: I will not turn around until the page is closed.
bless_line_three: If I hear my name, it is not my name.
output_mono: Mono: every sound in both ears, with a direction ring and subtitles
controls: Mouse looks. WASD walks. Shift sprints. C crouches. Space hops. Left button fires. Look down and hold the right button to load the revolver. Hold the right button on a door handle and draw circles to turn it. Tap F for the flashlight; hold F and shake the mouse to charge it. E hides and takes. Esc pauses.
hint_reload: Flick left to open the cylinder. Reach to your pocket, take a round, set it in a chamber. Flick right to close.
hint_door: Draw circles to turn the handle.
prompt_take_box: E: take the box of rounds
prompt_not_yet: The doors will not open. Not yet.
sub_shout: A shout: they have seen you
retry: Try again from the last door
won_text: Don't turn around until the page is closed.
no_webgl: This browser cannot draw the mall: it has no WebGL 2.
bless_done: The candle is lit. Go on.
